input.root_cause: StatsCache plugin: plugins/StatsCache/config.yml was changed to retain-history: true (reloaded at 08:19:58). With history retained, the in-memory stats history grew without bound (history-size: 1000 was not enforced; reached 1240 entries / ~355 MB), pushing heap from ~430 to ~732 of 768 MB.
input.actions: 1) Watched status/logs; saw heap climbing steadily after the StatsCache reload log line showing retain-history=true. 2) Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml and ran 'statscache stats' (1204 entries, ~344 MB held). 3) Declared incident. 4) Set retain-history: false in plugins/StatsCache/config.yml (history-size left at 1000); the plugin auto-reloaded it at 08:21:00. 5) Ran 'statscache flush' (freed 1240 entries, ~355 MB). 6) Checked afterward: heap dropped to ~313 MB and has stayed in the normal GC range (~310-415 MB) since; cache shows 0 entries; TPS 20; all plugins enabled; no restart.
input.residual_risk: retain-history is now off, so StatsCache does not keep stats history. If whoever enabled it needs that feature, it should only go back on after the plugin actually enforces history-size; otherwise the leak will come back. The cached history entries were flushed (in-memory cache only, not player world data). Heap should keep being watched for a while.

content.text:
I found and fixed a memory leak in the StatsCache plugin, with no restart and nobody disconnected. I declared the incident and filed the report.

- **Cause:** At 08:19:58 someone changed `plugins/StatsCache/config.yml` to `retain-history: true`. After that the plugin's history cache kept growing well past its `history-size: 1000` setting, to 1,240 entries holding about 355 MB. Server memory went from about 430 MB to 732 MB of the 768 MB limit, close to crashing.
- **Fix:** I set `retain-history` back to `false` (the plugin reloaded it at 08:21:00). Then I ran `statscache flush`, which cleared the cached history and freed about 355 MB. That was in-memory stats data only; no builds, items or player files were touched.
- **Check:** Memory dropped to about 313 MB and stayed between roughly 310 and 415 MB for the rest of the shift, which matches normal behaviour. The cache still showed 0 entries, the server held 20 TPS, all five plugins were enabled and both players stayed online.

**Still open:** turning `retain-history` off reverses a change someone made on purpose, so StatsCache isn't keeping stats history right now. Whoever turned it on should know it leaks, because the size limit isn't applied. It shouldn't be switched back on until the plugin actually enforces `history-size`.
